Name: Nyapu Style Portraits for Star Crossed
Author: Howaa
Description:
[b]Description[/b]
Portraits for  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/148527238]kcspace[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34252]Star Crossed - A Rival Hearts and Marriage Mod[/url] using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/nyapu?gameId=1303]Nyapu[/url]'s style as a base. In Star Crossed NPCs can get married and have children, this mod covers the potential offspring of the various pairings from the mod & features one design for each child in spring/summer/fall & one distinct winter portrait to match the sprites provided in the mod.

[b]Installation instructions[/b]
This is a file replacement mod! So you'll need to navigate to your mod folder, find "[CP]StarCrossed", and drag my "[CP]StarCrossed" folder into your mod folder, allow my portraits to overwrite the originals, and you're done! 

[b]Requirements[/b]
SMAPI, Star Crossed

[b]Shout outs[/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/HimeTarts?gameId=1303]Himetarts[/url] for their art, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/148527238]kcspace[/url] for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34252]Star Crossed - A Rival Hearts and Marriage Mod[/url] & permission to upload these retextures, and as always [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/54606682]nyapu[/url] for their portraits & generous permissions

Mods used in the cover image - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23647]Shane UI[/url] & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42851]Seasonal Portrait Backgrounds[/url]
